init_PACOResults: initialize a PACOResults object from ground truth annotations and detection results with a max detections limit
limit_dets_per_image: limit detections per image by sorting annotations by score and keeping only the top N results
get_top_results: get top detection results for a given image ID filtered by a minimum score threshold
get_im_joint_attr_cat_to_ann_id: get a mapping of image and joint attribute category pairs to their annotation IDs
review_PACOResults_class: review the PACOResults class that extends PACO to handle detection results with bbox and segmentation support
